title: Build the Bridge
setup: The c-pawn is one step from queening, but White is in check on the b-file and its rook is attacked as well.
hint: Two problems, one move. Is there a square where your rook blocks the check and your king already stands guard?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rb4}} blocks the check on a square the king defends: the bridge. {{Rxb4+}} {{Kxb4}}, and the pawn queens before the black king can stop it. Step aside with the king instead, and {{Rc1}} drops in behind the pawn in time.
